user_story: As a tester on https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/status_codes, I want to verify how the site reports HTTP status codes so that response handling can be checked end to end. Acceptance criteria: clicking the link with text '200' navigates to a URL containing '/status_codes/200' and the page body text contains 'This page returned a 200 status code'; returning to /status_codes and clicking the link with text '404' shows body text containing 'This page returned a 404 status code'.
